## Walkthrough

The change converts GTFS frequency records into API models and propagates them through arrival, stop-schedule, vehicle, trip-status, location, and route responses. It adds batch lookups, frequency grouping, exact-time expansion, agency-local service dates, and end-to-end coverage.

### Changes

**GTFS frequency API integration**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Frequency model conversion** `internal/models/frequency.go`, `internal/models/frequency_test.go`|Converts database rows into localized schedule frequency models with metadata, headway, and boundary flags.|
|**Stop schedule frequency grouping** `internal/restapi/schedule_for_stop_handler.go`, `internal/restapi/schedule_for_stop_handler_test.go`, `internal/restapi/frequency_fixture_test.go`|Groups headway frequencies separately from stop times and expands exact-time frequencies into shifted stop times.|
|**Arrival frequency responses** `internal/restapi/arrival_and_departure_for_stop_handler.go`, `internal/restapi/arrivals_and_departures_for_stop_handler.go`, `internal/restapi/*arrival*test.go`|Fetches, selects, converts, and attaches frequency records to arrival responses.|
|**Trip status and vehicle frequency responses** `internal/restapi/trips_helper.go`, `internal/restapi/trip_for_vehicle_handler.go`, `internal/restapi/trip_details_handler.go`, `internal/restapi/trips_helper_test.go`, `internal/restapi/trip_for_vehicle_handler_test.go`|Adds cached and batched frequency resolution to trip status, schedules, trip details, and vehicle responses.|
|**Location and route frequency propagation** `internal/restapi/trips_for_location_handler.go`, `internal/restapi/trips_for_route_handler.go`, `internal/restapi/trips_for_location_handler_test.go`, `internal/restapi/trips_for_route_handler_test.go`|Propagates resolved frequencies to location and route trip entries and schedules, including duplicated trips and agency-local service dates.|

This PR adds frequency data and overnight schedule resolution across several API handlers, but the current implementation can still panic on malformed or unresolved data, assign incorrect service dates to overnight or cross-agency trips, and return incomplete successful responses after database failures. These correctness and availability issues should be fixed before merge.
